'''Ventil Tamplin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Ragtags|Ragtag]] cudgel who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ventil Tamplin and [[Lilea Norith]] were leading a group of Ragtag cudgels in the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> they harassed the small-time thug [[Lilith Laughlin]] because they suspected her to be an informant for the [[Corellian Security Force]]. In fact, they were right and Laughlin was actually working for the CorSec. During the CorSec investigation against the criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] needed information from Lilith Laughlin. She thus dispatched an agent to deal with her Ragtag problem. The CorSec agent fought the Ragtag cudgels who bothered the informant and killed some of them, including Ventil Tamplin.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ventil Tamplin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ventil Tamplin was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
